title: A Mathematical Theory of Communication
lineage: Corrected reprint identifies July and October 1948 parts; Shannon names Nyquist and Hartley as theoretical foundations and extends their analysis to channel noise and source statistics.

passages.note: Corrected reprint identifies July and October 1948 parts; Shannon names Nyquist and Hartley as theoretical foundations and extends their analysis to channel noise and source statistics.

Corrected reprint section 17, pp. 27–28, attributes a seven-symbol, four-information-symbol single-error-correcting example to R. Hamming. It does not establish the full 1950 paper was already published.
